notes.title: Sulphur memories: Alchemist 0.4.1 content update is here + official Discord!
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="4vqxFJChRKM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[url="https://discord.gg/FF3qZeebFx"]Join the official Discord server here![/url][/p][p][/p][p]This update is incompatible with saves from previous versions due to changes to the world structure.
You can watch the video to see the changes in the new version, or read the changelog below.[/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog:[/h2][p][/p][h3]New content[/h3][p]Two new visitors in Ricardo's tavern:[/p][list][*][p]A fisherman with a sleep problem.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A wandering warrior looking for a strong potion.[/p][/*][/list][p]Two new side quests, given by the new visitors. Both quests involve you brewing the right potion.[/p][list][*][p]A straightforward quest for the fisherman.[/p][/*][*][p]A multiple-ending quest for the warrior, with a somewhat hidden consequence.[/p][/*][/list][p]Fishing.[/p][list][*][p]Unlocked by completing the fisherman's quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Fishing can be performed by wielding a fishing rod and interacting with any deep water tile.[/p][/*][*][p]Fishing in different areas yields different fish and different loot.[/p][/*][*][p]Fishing consumes bait (craftable).[/p][/*][*][p]Fishing repeatedly in the same area reduces the chance of catching a fish. Fish replenishes over time.[/p][/*][*][p]Scarlet flask works on the fish caught.[/p][/*][/list][p]Four new early-game areas (unlocked by talking to Ricardo, same as the rest of them):[/p][list][*][p]A shipwreck on the coast of the northern sea.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A strange standing stone on a hill.[/p][/*][*][p]A smuggler's hideout with some interesting items possibly still hidden.[/p][/*][*][p]Ruins of a burnt village of suspected cultists.[/p][/*][/list][p]Four new creatures:[/p][list][*][p]A frigid sea anemone.[/p][/*][*][p]A tiny lizard, encountered in rocky areas.[/p][/*][*][p]A capricorn.[/p][/*][*][p]An oozing darkness.[/p][/*][/list][p]Five new books, and related lore.[/p][p]New flora: clovers, growing in open, grassy areas.[/p][p]A plethora of new loot, found both in new and old areas, to provide some extra flavour.[/p][list][*][p]Various new jewellery: pearls, bracelets, earrings...[/p][/*][*][p]All kinds of fish-related items: scales, whiskers, roe...[/p][/*][*][p]Rare and powerful rewards: sealed whisper, Jubjub's feather, gilded helmet, liquid darkness...[/p][/*][*][p]And others.[/p][/*][/list][p]Two new research nodes.[/p][p]Two new tools:[/p][list][*][p]Clockwork sorter. When enabled, it automatically converts (grinds or sorts) items that have only one possible output. It does nothing to items with multiple processing options, consumables, tools, books, or items that can only be distilled. Essentially, a quality of life tool, added per requests of some players. Unlocked by the new "Automatons" research.[/p][/*][*][p]Clockwork assistant. Reduces the cost of all materials (except fuel) for potion brewing by 20%. Unlocked by the new "Automatons" research.[/p][/*][/list][p]Two new potions:[/p][list][*][p]Lingering fireball potion. Spawns a lingering fireball that explodes in 4 turns, or when detonated by heat or another explosion. Unlocked by the new "Advanced thermodynamics" research.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam potion. Spawns a cloud of steam that drenches whatever stands within it, making it immune to fire, similar to a water tile. Unlocked by the new "Advanced thermodynamics" research.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Presentation[/h3][p]New music for the burnt spire areas.[/p][p]New music for natural caves.[/p][p]Bat movement sounds are significantly quieter now.[/p][p][/p][h3]Balance[/h3][p]A lot of changes to loot tables and merchant inventories. Some chaos may be introduced.[/p][p]Pickaxes and agricultural implements give more of something telluric when distilled.[/p][p]Tall boots now protect from damage when walking through rose bushes.[/p][list][*][p]As per request of some players.[/p][/*][/list][p]Verdant sandals, in addition to allowing you to grow grass, now protect you from nettle and rose bushes, and apply the "stimulated" effect when you walk through them instead. This effect can restore your vitality up to 10.[/p][list][*][p]As per request of some players, plus sandals really were the least useful item to wear.[/p][/*][/list][p]Gargoyles, fiend's powderbox mushrooms and smoulderflies will no longer trigger while the time is frozen.[/p][p][/p][h3]Interface[/h3][p]Changed the way popups (loot, quests, etc) fade out. Now, instead of the whole stack of popups fading out at the same time, only the top one is fading out, but the speed increases with how many popups there are on the screen at once. This should make it easier to read them when several popups appear on the screen at once.[/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][p]Fixed a crash upon opening the trading interface for the first time since the game launch while the merchant has nothing to sell.[/p][p]Fixed a potentially game-breaking bug that happened if you autosaved while dying (i. e. by walking upstairs on the same turn when you're killed, when enough time has passed since the last auto-save). The bug used to not only crash your game, but also delete your save.[/p][p]Fixed the game unintentionally switching the action to "throw nothing" when activating the "throw" action via the specific action key, and throwing your last potion.[/p][p]Fixed creatures not getting wet initially when placed in the water upon spawn.[/p][p]Fixed the wyrm ambush in the mines destroying loot, if you were to break or burn the chest the wyrm is falling onto, before triggering the ambush.[/p][p]Fixed the lantern burning for 1 turn when enabled, even if you have no fuel for it.[/p][p]Fixed certain objects triggering their on-move effects when the player was trying to move onto them, but was blocked by a creature.[/p][p]Fixed several icons being imported in a lower resolution than they are supposed to.[/p][p]Fixed floating point errors causing speed to sometimes display as 99% instead of 100% (it was actually 99.999999, so it had no effect on the actual gameplay).[/p][p]Fixed certain creatures (phantasms, efreets) avoiding dangerous tiles like fire or poison clouds, even though they can't hurt them.[/p][p]Fixed skipping the frozen time animation leaving music in a slowed-down state instead of stopping it completely.[/p][p]Fixed some sprites appearing to have a gap while in water when a non-standard scale was used.[/p][p]Fixed white outlines appearing around certain tiles when a non-standard scale was used.[/p][p]Fixed right-click actions coming through even when they should be interrupted (including by death).[/p][p]Fixed music permanently stopping when dying during frozen time.[/p][p]Fixed a crash when dying while under the inner fire status effect.[/p][p]Minor grammar and spelling errors fixed.[/p][p]Uncountable items are now all properly labelled as "a <unit> of <substance>" or "some <substance>".[/p][p][/p][h3]Performance[/h3][p]Further decreased RAM usage.[/p][p]Made some minor performance improvements related to lighting.[/p][p]Compressed the map texture in hopes that it will help people that encounter VRAM issues upon loading the map.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your attention. The next update will most likely be focused on UX and further quality-of-life additions.[/p]

notes.title: Sulphur memories: Alchemist 0.3.2 QoL and balance update is here!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2JMXLcrkjhc;full][previewyoutube=2JMXLcrkjhc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

The update is partially compatible with saves from 0.3.1 (Some of the new features will only work on new saves).
As new controls have been added, you might have to solve the keybindings conflicts if you set up custom keybindings before.
You can watch the video to see the changes in the new version, or read the changelog below.

[h2]Changelog:
[/h2]
[h3]Presentation[/h3]
[list]
New sounds for ghouls.
New sounds for efreets.
New sound for the potion of unruly flame.
New sounds for looting animal remains.
New music for the sewers (will only take effect on new save files).
Particle effects when looting stumps and sacks.
Active gargoyle statues in dungeons now have eyes flashing red, to better distinguish them from inactive ones.
Better water tiles (only has an effect when water shaders are disabled).
[/list]

[h3]Quality of life
[/h3]	
[list]
New quick harvest button.
[list]
[*] The default key is 'F'.
[*] Clicking the button (or pressing the key) causes you to gather loot from every neighbouring cell. Looting each individual object still takes a turn.
[*] Similar to other queued actions, this will stop when threatened or taking damage. Pressing the button when threatened will only make you loot one object at a time.
[*] Quick harvest will not automatically open locked containers.
[/list]
Aiming interface now displays the currently selected action on the "exit" button.
Specific action keys.
[list]
[*] The setting "Specific action keys behaviour" under Options -> Gameplay -> Controls controls the way this feature behaves. 
[*] "Press to aim" will open the aiming interface on button press. 
[*] "Press to select" will switch to the key-specific action on button press. 
[*] "Hold to override" (intended to be used with mouse controls) will change the selected action to the key-specific action while the button is held, and switch back when released.
[*] The default keybindings are: 'T' for throw, 'Y' for push, 'G' for interact, 'B' for hit.
[/list]
New controls settings to go with the above feature:
[list]
[*] Auto-switch to "throw" when equipping potions from the hotbar. When enabled (default), equipping a throwable potion from the hotbar also switches the selected action to "throw". This is how the game behaved before, however, this might not be ideal if you're using specific action keys, which is why it can be disabled now.
[*] Mouse wheel to switch actions. When enabled (default), you can scroll the mouse wheel to switch actions. If you want to avoid switching them accidentally, it can now be disabled.
"Press and hold to confirm research" setting. If disabled (new default), the research is done with a single button press. If enabled, you will need to hold the key in the research interface for a short time to confirm research. This is how the game behaved before, and can be switched to if you preferred it that way. Some people were confused by having to hold the button, which is why it's not the default behaviour.
[/list]
"Tutorials" tab in the journal.
[list]
[*] The tutorials contain detailed information on the game's basic features, and are intended for when you get confused or need a refresher.
[*] If you choose to play through the prologue, tutorials are unlocked gradually as relevant topics come up during the prologue.
[*] If you skip the prologue, or load a save from the previous version, all tutorials are unlocked immediately.
[/list]
Certain explanations during the prologue that caused people to get confused, are made significantly more blatant.
When choosing 1 life, the game explicitly warns that it's not recommended for the first playthrough.
"Action" button in the HUD now displays two keys: the key to perform the action, and the key to open the actions menu.
In the inventory, books now display the type of knowledge they give and how much you can learn from copies of a particular book.
[list]
[*] This is most useful when shopping, so you can know if the book is of use to you before you buy it.
[/list]
Books that contain no more useful knowledge now automatically turn into paper when used.
[list]
[*]Books can no longer be scrapped manually.
[/list]
Areas on the world map can now be marked as favourite.
[list]
[*]Favourite areas are displayed at the top of the list.
[/list]
Areas on the world map are now automatically marked as complete when you reach the final reward.
[list]
[*]This feature will not work for areas created in old versions.
[/list]
Areas on the world map can be deleted manually.
[list]
[*] You can not delete unique areas.
[*] This feature will not work for areas created in old versions.
[/list]
Areas are now automatically cleaned up when not visited for a prolonged time.
[list]
[*] There are separated settings under Options -> System -> Data for cleaning up complete and not complete areas. The default is 12 and 3 in-game months.
[*] Unique areas are never cleaned up.
[*] Favourite areas are never cleaned up.
[*] This feature will not work for areas created in old versions.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
Itchy skin effect can no longer lower your health below 10. The description now also correctly states 10%, not 20% to take damage every turn.
[list]
[*] While it was never a dangerous effect to begin with, people seemed to overreact to it a lot, though the intention was for it to be a minor annoyance.
[/list]
Kingsblood simulacrum duration buffed from 15 to 45 turns.
[list]
[*] It seems like with 15 turns of duration, kingsblood's only use was to activate 1 statue per potion. I want other applications (such as pacifying crystal guardians) to be more viable.
[/list]
Potion of disruption's stun duration buffed from 3 to 5 turns. The description now also mentions that it affect inanimate magical objects.
[list]
[*] Since the potion of disruption's effect on immaterial creatures is outright destroying the target, it never made sense to use them for just 3 turns of stun instead. I want them to be viable for a wider range of situations.
[/list]
Coagulant's crafting cost changed: something sanguine 0.25 -> 0.1
[list]
[*] Since it's primarily an early game potion, and a very niche one, the cost was too much to justify ever making it.
[/list]
Centipede's mandibles processing output changed. Old processing output was too irrelevant for how late in the game you find centipedes.
[list]
[*] Grind: 1x something telluric (changed from 1x something dead).
[*] Distill: 0.5x something umbral (changed from 1x something toxic).
[/list]
Destroyed phantasms now leave a cloud of fog behind, that can be harvested for phantasmal mist.
[list]
[*] Phantasmal mist can be processed into 1x something boreal by sorting, 1x something phantom by distilling.
[*] Phantasmal mist can also rarely be found among generic occult-related loot.
[/list]
Unmelting ice can now be found among major rewards.
[list]
[*] Unmelting ice can be processed into 10x something boreal by sorting, 1x something sempiternal by distilling.
[/list]
Significantly expanded the pool of books for lategame areas to include many of the early game books.
[list]
[*] Since in these areas, the number of books is overall much higher, the player would very quickly reach the point of finding no new knowledge when exploring the lategame areas, which would disincentivise future visits.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes
[/h3]	
[list]
Fixed whispering candle not whispering anything in bewitched woods (tier 2 area).
Fixed a rare generation error that would cause the ring that opens the secret area in mage's house, to appear inside the secret area sometimes.
Fixed a rare generation error that would cause centipedes to spawn over deep water in caves (and often get stuck).
Fixed the hotbar not immediately updating when torches burn out or the lantern runs out of fuel.
Removed an unnecessary 1-frame delay between turns.
Various minor grammar and typo fixes.
[/list]
[h3]Other
[/h3]	
[list]
"Controls" tab under Options -> Gameplay is split into "Controls" and "UX".
Reduced RAM usage by ~400 MB.
Reduced loading time on startup.
Updated LÖVE to 11.5.
[/list]

Thank you for your attention. The next update will be dedicated to adding more early-game content.
